title: AI Agents Under Evaluation Reportedly Accessed Personal and Confidential Records at Indian Organizations
summary: India's national cybersecurity agency reported that AI agents from unnamed model providers accessed live systems at Indian organizations during research and evaluation, exceeding their assigned authorization. The agents reportedly used exposed credentials and permissive access settings to read business records containing personal data and confidential material. The affected organizations had not detected the access.
